scope: Bounded samples and primary terms, not a full training-data quality audit.

checks.access_proof: UCI CSV prefix parsed: 303 complete rows, 15 columns; sensor and reference fields present.
checks.licence: UCI currently displays CC BY 4.0; embedded historical terms restrict use to research and exclude commercial use. Proposed thesis stays within the intersection.
checks.uncertainty: One historic outdoor installation, 2004–2005; no indoor, multi-device or modern regulatory claim. Do not transfer the thesis data into a venture without resolving the terms.

checks.access_proof: Zenodo metadata and file list read; development archive returned HTTP 403 using ordinary public GET and bounded range requests. No actual audio sample obtained.
checks.uncertainty: Licence metadata is not proof of usable file access; no qualified topic until a permitted public route actually works.

checks.access_proof: Complete official label TIFF and S1/S2 chips downloaded. Label decoded as 512 by 512 with -1/0/1 values. Both official STAC collections declare proprietary.
checks.licence: Unresolved: official source and label STAC say proprietary, while other descriptions/mirrors imply openness.
checks.uncertainty: GitHub issue 18 remains open; all two replies read, last 2026-09-15 asks the same clarification. No maintainer resolution found.

checks.access_proof: UK-DALE owner page and REFIT publisher/Zenodo metadata read. UK-DALE legacy host redirected away from data; actual cleaned REFIT CSV and publisher files returned 403.
checks.uncertainty: A separate Figshare REFIT Smart Home record was inspected but is not the electrical-load dataset and is not treated as substitute access.

checks.access_proof: Complete L-Town nominal EPANET network (412,200 bytes), dataset README and generator source downloaded; generator imports WNTR and explicitly creates leak nodes. SCADA pressure CSV returned 403.
checks.licence: Network/data record CC BY 4.0; generator EUPL 1.2 with README permitting 1.1 or later.
checks.uncertainty: Use freshly generated simulations only. Neither held-out benchmark SCADA nor operational field data are claimed available; simulator execution has not yet been tested.

checks.access_proof: Sleep-EDF public signal EDF prefix parsed; full 4,620-byte hypnogram fetched and sleep labels parsed.
checks.licence: Open Data Commons Attribution License 1.0 on PhysioNet; not CC BY.
checks.uncertainty: Full nights were not downloaded. Historical cohorts and scorer labels do not establish clinical benefit; check model/software terms before redistributing weights.

checks.access_proof: Public PTB-XL metadata prefix parsed, complete waveform header read, and full 24,000-byte 100-Hz 12-lead ECG record decoded.
checks.uncertainty: No institutional credentials/new agreement required for these files. Clinical deployment, patient benefit and external-hospital validity are not established.

checks.access_proof: All 100 STEAD sample traces and metadata decoded (7.57 MB). Separately decoded a complete real noise trace from official SeisBench HDF5 using 99,480 bytes in 15 bounded range requests.
checks.licence: STEAD CC BY 4.0 confirmed in official distribution/source.
checks.uncertainty: 100-sample file contains earthquakes only; it is not a negative dataset. Full SeisBench waveform object is about 91 GB and was not downloaded. Larger pilot requires selective ranges and a streamed metadata pass.

checks.access_proof: First 1 MiB of official Speech Commands v0.02 archive yielded a complete 16-kHz mono WAV: 16,000 frames. Dataset licence verified on primary Google release page.
checks.licence: CC BY 4.0 for Speech Commands; software/other checkpoints retain their own terms.
checks.uncertainty: The verified archive is about 2.43 GB compressed; use a small deterministic subset first. No long real-background corpus was verified for this proposal; do not claim continuous-listening results.

checks.access_proof: OpenNeuro ds004196 v2.0.2 metadata declares CC0. Complete labels/channel metadata read; public S3 returned 1 MiB of a 152,513,024-byte BDF and a complete one-second record was decoded: 73 channels, 512 samples per channel.
checks.licence: Dataset CC0; LTU preprocessing repository GPL-3.0.
checks.uncertainty: Only four healthy participants; cue/inner-speech timing and event units require reconciliation. Actual files are accessible, but aligned training epochs have not yet been established. No patient/clinical benefit inference.

checks.access_proof: Complete 33,930,838-byte parquet sample downloaded and decoded: 200 image/annotation rows; first JPEG 1081x1400 with 138 boxes. Full train/validation/test archives and annotation JSON files are public in repository metadata.
checks.licence: Apache-2.0 declared in official dataset card
checks.uncertainty: Before committing, inventory unique signature-bearing document families and group overlap using full annotation metadata. Require enough independent held-out families for meaningful intervals; otherwise drop this topic or change the claim, not duplicate crops to inflate sample size.

checks.access_proof: 50,000,000 bytes fetched in two bounded HTTP ranges from a 1,295,308,933-byte archive. Nested archives yielded matching original JPEG and pixel mask for CB55 page 0019r, both 4872x6496, and its PAGE XML. Decoding succeeded. The archive is a website mirror containing nested zip files; a single flat image folder should not be assumed.
checks.licence: CC-BY-4.0 explicitly returned by unauthenticated Zenodo metadata API
checks.uncertainty: Three manuscripts severely limit generalisation; no invented independent-writer count.
